blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Retired Supreme Court Associate Justice Arturo Brion has nominated Associate Justice Jose Midas Marquez as the next chief justice. “I had the privilege of witnessing Associate Justice Marquez’s exemplary work ethic and dedication to public service during my tenure in the Court, particularly while he served as Court Administrator,” Brion said in a letter to Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo and members of the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) dated Sept. 4, 2026. The JBC is already accepting nominations for chief justice as Gesmundo is set to retire on Nov. 6, 2026. In his letter, Brion praised Marquez’s extensive […]...
